name: Astalias SEO Tower
author: jopels

sections.description:
Astalias SEO Tower turns WordPress into a practical SEO control room: realistic health scoring, actionable scan results, automatic redirects for changed links, and optional instant indexing notifications.

Core features (FREE):

  • Control Room dashboard with dynamic SEO Health Score, score drivers, and next actions
  • Tower Scan: practical scan to detect common SEO blockers (robots, indexing settings, homepage title/meta/canonical, sitemaps, basic duplicates)
  • Smart Fix: one-click fixes for common blockers
  • Redirect Manager: rule-based redirects, automatic redirects when URLs change, ordering/priority, chain & loop detection, 404 hit counter, CSV import/export
  • Instant Index (IndexNow) (optional): notify participating search engines when URLs change

Privacy:

  • This plugin does not track visitors and does not collect personal data.
  • All scans and rules run locally on your WordPress site.
  • Optional instant indexing may send your site URLs to an external service (see below).

External services

Astalias SEO Tower can connect to external services only if the site administrator enables the related feature(s). These connections are optional and can be disabled at any time from Astalias SEO Tower → Notifications.

Instant Index (IndexNow) submission (optional)

Used to notify participating search engines of changed URLs on your site for faster discovery/indexing. This plugin submits to the Bing IndexNow endpoint.

  • What it is used for: Send changed URLs to IndexNow to help search engines discover updates faster.
  • What data is sent: A JSON payload containing your site hostname (host), your IndexNow key and key URL (key, keyLocation), and a list of changed URLs from your site (urlList).
  • When it is sent: Only if enabled by an administrator. It may send on publish/update actions and/or when you manually submit the queue from the Instant Index screen.
  • Where it is sent: https://www.bing.com/indexnow
  • Terms of Service: https://www.microsoft.com/servicesagreement
  • Privacy Policy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement
  • Protocol documentation: https://www.indexnow.org/documentation
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/astalias-seo-tower/ or install it via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to SEO Tower in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin collect user data?

No. The plugin does not track visitors and does not collect personal data.

Does this plugin connect to external services?

Optionally. If enabled by the site administrator, the plugin can submit changed URLs to the Bing IndexNow endpoint as described in the “External services” section above. You can disable this at any time from Astalias SEO Tower → Notifications.
sections.changelog:
1.889

  • Improved dynamic SEO Health Score calculation for more realistic scan results.
  • Expanded homepage SEO checks for title, meta description, canonical, noindex, and reachability.
  • Added automatic redirect creation when a published URL changes.
  • Improved Control Room guidance with clearer score drivers and next actions.
  • Small stability and admin experience improvements.

1.888

  • Added a dynamic SEO Health Score with score drivers, score deltas, and more realistic scan weighting.
  • Expanded homepage checks for title, meta description, canonical, noindex, and homepage reachability.
  • Added automatic redirect creation when a published URL changes.

1.885

  • Removed trademark symbols from UI labels.
  • Removed Sitemap Ping notifications (Google/Bing).
  • Added full external services disclosure for optional Instant Index (IndexNow), including data details and policy links.

1.884

  • Additional input sanitization fixes (nonce, REQUEST_URI, dir).
  • Readme fixes (license + tags + short description).

1.883

  • Security hardening: improved input validation/unslashing and safer CSV import.
  • Added uninstall.php cleanup (options, transients, cron schedules, and DB tables).
  • Small DB query hardening for WP.org compliance.

1.882

  • WordPress.org clean build (no license gates)
  • Packaging + stability improvements

1.881

  • Redirect Manager improvements (ordering/priority, chain/loop detection)
  • 404 hit counter and CSV import/export
  • Smart Fix and admin UI improvements
